# DELETE goes by the kind of the path: a collection path deletes the
# collection (never an entry of a like name), an entry path the entry
# (never a collection). The last own calendar and the address book stay.
@seed calendar privat arbeit.ics dentist.ics
@collection calendar arbeit Arbeit
@seed calendar arbeit 2F0E6A64-1B7C-4E5A-9C1D-6A8E0B3D4C21.ics weekly-team.ics

> DELETE /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/arbeit.ics/
> Auth: alex
< status 404

> DELETE /caldav/alex/calendars/arbeit/
> Auth: alex
> If-Match: "0-0"
< status 412

> DELETE /caldav/alex/calendars/arbeit/
> Auth: alex
< status 204

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
< status 207
< responses 3
# (and the virtual reminder list, 1.13: reminders.txt)
< response-lacks /caldav/alex/calendars/arbeit/

> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/arbeit.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 200
< body dentist.ics

> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/arbeit/2F0E6A64-1B7C-4E5A-9C1D-6A8E0B3D4C21.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 404

# The entry path deletes the entry; privat stays.
> DELETE /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/arbeit.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 204

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
< status 207
< responses 1

# privat is the last one now.
> DELETE /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
< status 403

> DELETE /caldav/alex/calendars/privat
> Auth: alex
< status 403

> DELETE /carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/
> Auth: alex
< status 403

> DELETE /caldav/alex/calendars/
> Auth: alex
< status 405

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 0
< status 207
